title: Grade 9 · Session 22 · Build V16
note: Holes are counted from the left, the front or the bottom, as the finished model faces the camera: motor on the right, front frame at the front.

steps.instruction: Hold the motor so the holes on its sides run horizontally.
Push a pin into the motor face, in the hole beside its shaft.
Push a pin into the motor face, in the other hole beside its shaft.
Fix a size 9 beam onto both pins, using holes 7 and 9.
Insert the size 4 axle into the motor shaft.
Slide a 16-tooth gear onto the size 4 axle.
Fix a perpendicular axle joiner into holes 2 and 4 of the size 9 beam.
Take a 10x5 block.
Push a size 10 axle through hole 7 of the 10x5 block.
steps.check: The 3D model still shows the old size 9 axle; the real build uses a size 10 axle.

steps.instruction: Slide a 16-tooth gear onto the axle's short right end.
Join both assemblies as shown.
Push a pin into the 10x5 block's bottom row, hole 8.
Push a pin into the 10x5 block's bottom row, hole 4.
Attach a size 9 beam onto the pins, using holes 3 and 7.
Push a pin into hole 8 of the size 9 beam.
Push a pin into hole 2 of the size 9 beam.
Attach an 11x5 plate to the size 9 beam.
Slide a 40-tooth gear onto the size 10 axle, all the way to the 10x5 block.
Slide an 8-tooth gear on, leaving a 2-hole gap after the 40-tooth gear.
steps.check: The 3D model still shows the old size 9 axle, so it shows a 1.5-hole gap here, not 2.

steps.instruction: Push a size 16 axle through hole 4 of the 10x5 block.
Slide an 8-tooth gear onto the size 16 axle.
Slide the second 40-tooth gear onto the size 16 axle, all the way to the 8-tooth gear.
Slide a 24-tooth gear onto the size 16 axle, against the 40-tooth gear.
Slide the other 24-tooth gear onto the size 10 axle, leaving a 2-hole gap from the 8-tooth gear.
steps.check: The 3D model still shows the old size 9 axle, so it shows a 1.5-hole gap here, not 2.

steps.instruction: Push a pin into the 11x5 plate's left side, hole 9 from the front.
Push a pin into the 11x5 plate's left side, hole 6 from the front.
Push a pin into the 11x5 plate's left side, hole 3 from the front.
Attach the second 10x5 block onto the three left pins; the size 16 axle goes through top hole 4.
Turn the whole model upside down.
Push a pin into the 11x5 plate's underside, second row from the front, hole 5.
Push a pin into the 11x5 plate's underside, second row from the front, hole 1.
Connect a 15x5 block onto both pins, using its front row, holes 1 and 5.
Turn the whole model back the right way up.
Push a pin into the motor's side, bottom hole nearest the size 9 beam.
steps.check: The 3D model still puts this pin in the top hole; Tarun says it goes in the bottom hole.

steps.instruction: Push a pin into the motor's side, lower hole at the far right end.
Push a pin into the motor's side, top hole at the far right end.
Connect a 7x7 block onto the three pins on the motor.
Push a pin into the 7x7 block's right side, second hole from the bottom.
Push a pin into the 7x7 block's left side, second hole from the bottom.
Push a pin into the 11x5 plate's back edge, hole 5 from the left.
Push a pin into the 11x5 plate's back edge, hole 3 from the left.
Attach a size 15 beam onto the four back pins, using holes 2, 4, 9 and 15.

Start the servo assembly in front of the model: servo in its holder, shaft up. The servo's shaft is off-centre, so keep it on the side away from the gears. The servo is screwed into its holder, with the shaft attached.
Push a pin up into the servo holder's right hole from below.
Push a pin up into the servo holder's left hole from below.
Connect the servo assembly over the 15x5 block; lower its pins into front row holes 10 and 12.
Start the front frame assembly: take an 11x5 H block.
Push a pin into the H block's back, top row, hole 5 from the left.
Push a pin into the H block's back, top row, hole 3 from the left.
Connect a size 11 beam onto the top pins, using holes 5 and 7.
Push a pin into the H block's back, bottom row, hole 5 from the left.
Push a pin into the H block's back, bottom row, hole 3 from the left.
Connect a size 5 beam onto the bottom pins, using holes 3 and 5.
Push a pin into the size 11 beam's back, hole 1 at the left end.
Push a pin into the size 11 beam's back, hole 8 from the left.
Push a pin into the size 5 beam's back, hole 1 at the left end.
Push a pin into the size 5 beam's back, hole 4 from the left.
Connect the front frame onto the model: top pins into both 10x5 blocks, bottom pins into the plate.
Start sub-assembly 7 on the mat, front left: lay a size 5 beam front to back.
Lay a second size 5 beam parallel, one hole to its left.
Push a pin into the right beam's front hole.
Push a pin into the left beam's front hole.
Push a pin into the left beam's back hole.
Push a pin into the right beam's back hole.
Press a size 3 beam across the two front pins, using its end holes.
Press the second size 3 beam across the two back pins, using its end holes.
Turn sub-assembly 7 upside down.
Push a pin into the back size 3 beam's middle hole, between the long beams.
Turn sub-assembly 7 back over and leave it flat on the mat.
Start sub-assembly 8 on the mat, front right: lay a 7x2 C beam front to back.
Lay the second 7x2 C beam beside it, flipped, one hole to its right.
Push a pin into the left C beam's front end, left hole.
Push the long pin through the left C beam's front end, right hole; it sticks out below.
Push a pin into the right C beam's front end, left hole.
Push a pin into the right C beam's front end, right hole.
Connect a size 5 beam across the front ends onto all four pins: holes 1, 2, 4 and 5.
Press the lift arm onto the servo shaft, its far end pointing toward the size 16 axle.
Attach a peg joiner down into the lift arm's far-end hole.
Slide a half bush onto the size 16 axle's right end.
Slide a second half bush on, against the first.
Slide the hole pin onto the size 16 axle, its pin pointing up.
Slide a half bush on, against the hole pin.
Slide the last half bush on, against the third.
Press the second peg joiner down onto the hole pin's pin.
Lift the C beam assembly onto the model: long pin into the H block's 2nd hole from the right, C beams either side of the peg joiners.
Lower the beam assembly onto the C beams; the pin on the size 3 beam goes into the top peg joiner.
